answer: One defence is Stamped newspaper publisher licence with press regulator attestation: a licence the regulator renews after standards audits, and the vertex of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because a licence the regulator renews after standards audits, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the lotus for an established agent is already paid and proven. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ripple of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
